patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the VIP-only fonts, note backgrounds, stickers and drawing tools. The app checks entitlement entirely locally — there is no license server — so forcing the App.isVip() gate to return true unlocks everything, and stays unlocked even though BillingManager resets the underlying purchase flags from Play on every startup.

The patch forces the premium entitlement (PlayBillingProvider's _isPremium StateFlow) to always be true.
